title: Cosmos Bank hack — Pune
desc: Hackers attacked the bank's card-payment system with malware and its SWIFT link. About ₹78 crore went out in more than 12,000 ATM withdrawals outside India, ₹13.92 crore was sent to a firm in Hong Kong, and about ₹2.5 crore was taken in transactions inside India. A Pune court convicted 11 people in April 2023.

title: Kerala AI deepfake call — Kozhikode
amount: ₹40,000 lost to a fake video call
desc: A retired executive in Kozhikode got a WhatsApp video call showing what looked like a friend, asking urgently for money for a sister's surgery. He sent ₹40,000, and grew suspicious only when the caller asked for ₹30,000 more. Kerala Police described it as the first case of its kind in Kerala to use AI-made video.

verdict.text: 🔴 First AI-video fraud reported in Kerala

title: Nadia digital arrest — West Bengal
amount: About ₹1 crore lost · 9 sentenced to life
desc: A retired scientist was told by a caller posing as Mumbai Police that he was under "digital arrest" and moved about ₹1 crore across several accounts. On 20 July 2025 a court in Kalyani, Nadia, sentenced nine members of the network to life imprisonment. The prosecutor called it India's first conviction in a digital arrest case; police said the gang had cheated at least 108 people.

title: Operation Octopus 2 — Hyderabad
amount: ₹150 crore · 52 arrested, 32 of them bank officers
desc: In April 2026 Hyderabad City Police arrested 52 people across nine states, including 32 bank officers, 15 mule-account holders and five middlemen. Police said 350 bank accounts linked to 850 cybercrime cases were used to move victims' money. The case shows why a stranger's account number is never a reason to trust a payment request.
